sloka: अकाले चापि मुख्यानि मूलानि च फलानि च ।नद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र तिष्ठेयुर्यत्र वानराः ।। ६.१२३.९ ।।
transliteration: akāle cāpi mukhyāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca ।nadyaśca vimalāstatra tiṣṭheyuryatra vānarāḥ ।। 6.123.9 ।।

translations.english: "Bestower of honour! I wish to see the longtailed Vanaras, and Bears rid of pain and death, enriched with strength and courage."
